answer.answer: No study in this dataset has a sampling window confined to 2000-2004 (the few records touching that era span decades, e.g. 1986-2008), so no median concentration for that period can be computed, making a ratio to 2020-2024 undefined. Even the 2020-2024 entries vary by over three orders of magnitude depending on region and collection method (nets vs. buckets vs. pumps), so any apparent change reflects where/how sampling was done rather than a true ocean-wide rise in microplastics.
